summary: Master smart city disaster risk reduction. Learn to integrate IoT, AI, and GIS for urban resilience in this 5-day expert-led course. Enroll today.
lede: Smart city disaster risk reduction uses digital infrastructure and data to assess urban hazards and support preparedness and response. For professionals working in urban safety, infrastructure resilience, or digital transformation, the course addresses how to plan technology-enabled risk management. Learners practise GIS-based hazard mapping, designing IoT early warning systems, and applying predictive analytics to crisis response.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for mid-to-senior level professionals responsible for urban safety, infrastructure resilience, and digital transformation within municipal or national governance structures.
modules: Urban Risk Assessment and ISO Standards
IoT Infrastructure and Early Warning Systems
AI and Predictive Analytics for Crisis Management
Digital Twins and Critical Infrastructure Protection
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of the disaster management cycle (mitigation, preparedness, response, recovery) and familiarity with urban planning or municipal governance principles. No prior coding or programming experience is required, though a working knowledge of data dashboards and basic GIS concepts is beneficial for the technical exercises.
